insights.one_liner: Saipem is an Italian energy-services contractor building offshore and onshore pipelines and plants; its Dutch entity is an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: An Italian energy-services company that builds offshore and onshore pipelines, platforms and plants.
Headquartered in Milan, founded in 1956, with Alessandro Puliti as CEO.

open.text: Saipem Contracting Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
The Dutch entity is owned by Italian parent SAIPEM S.P.A.

growth.text: Won a $350 million contract for the West Hub Tails project in Angola.
Completed a $285 million sale of its Saudi drilling business to ADES.
Won commissioning work on Türkiye's Sakarya gas field and an engineering contract for Profertil's expansion in Argentina.

worth_knowing.text: Is merging with Subsea7; its CEO says he is confident of regulatory clearance.
A Norwegian audit found maintenance and maritime system deficiencies on a Saipem rig.
